sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
JOIN set_translations st ON fd.language = st.language AND st.setCode = c.setCode
WHERE st.translation = 'Hauptset Zehnte Edition' AND c.artist = 'Adam Rex'
